description: At Stop, records that the hooks ran and asks an agent hook to call the cprobe connector's ping and report, through its reason, what tools it had and what the call returned.

hooks.prompt:
This is a connectivity probe, not a check of the conversation. The hook input is: $ARGUMENTS
If that input has stop_hook_active set to true, return ok=true at once with reason "second pass" and do nothing else.
Otherwise: 1. Note the names of every tool available to you whose name contains mcp, cprobe or ping, including tools you can find with a tool search. 2. Call the ping tool of the cprobe MCP server once, with via set to "agent hook v12", and note its result or error. 3. Return ok=false with a reason that begins "PROBE REPORT:" and gives the tool names from step 1 and the result from step 2. Never fail to return a result.
